lines: The player answers 1.00 questions/second. Everything else grows.
Hiring peaks throughput at 4.56 tasks/s. Then it falls to 1.67.
The agent designs. The agent proves. A human must approve.
Evidence is bound. No token. No signature. No patch.
Autonomy is earned. It is revoked. Simulation was not enough.
The floor decides. The floor decides what stays.

note: Written by the headcount-narrator agent running on the same TrueForge instance as the designer, from a fixed evidence brief, with every figure checked against that brief before the copy was accepted. Two takes were generated; a human chose this one. The second was vaguer and contained a factual error ('hiring raises floor, lowers ceiling'), which is the same reason every other agent output here gets read before it ships.
